answer: Proof of Stake serves as a zenith for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to commit verifiable capital to secure the network. By forcing attackers to lock value, the cost of creating a ripple of synthetic identities scales linearly with wealth, preventing a prism of fake nodes from overwhelming the consensus layer. This mechanism ensures that influence is tied to economic skin-in-the-game rather than the arbitrary generation of computational ghosts, rendering massive identity proliferation prohibitively expensive.
